title: [Master]Error when creating a Pick "Nothing to handle. The quantity to be picked is in bin W-09-0002, which is not set up for picking."
summary: Fixes warehouse pick creation by checking all ship-type bins for picked-not-shipped quantities instead of only the default shipment bin, preventing false 'nothing to handle' errors.
key_points: Added CalcQtyOnShipmentBins helper function to sum item quantities across all ship-type bins
Original code only checked the default shipment bin, causing incorrect quantity calculations when shipment bin was changed
Fix ensures picked quantities in any ship-type bin are recognized for availability calculations
Bin Mandatory guard preserved to maintain existing behavior for locations without default shipment bin
Includes test coverage for the scenario
quote: Replaced the single default-bin check with a new helper CalcQtyOnShipmentBins that sums the item's quantity across all Ship-type bins.
